Implemented the CLI in [main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with the core parser/expander in [lib.js](/workspace/output/lib.js) and a wrapper command in [ical](/workspace/output/ical). It runs as requested with `node /workspace/output/main.js ...`, uses only the Node.js standard library, and writes all source under `output/`.

I verified targeted cases for `parse` and `expand`, including base events, RRULE expansion, `RDATE`/`EXDATE`, deprecated `EXRULE` handling, override replacement, `RECURRENCE-ID` cancellation, `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`, VTIMEZONE-based UTC conversion, DST fold/gap handling with warnings, unresolved `TZID`, all-day events, VAVAILABILITY parsing, and iTIP required-property warnings.
